tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: Ducats are untradeable; only the Prime parts that sell for them trade.
Maroo's Bazaar has no Ducat Kiosk; use any other Relay.

alt.text: or 100 Aya at Varzia, 5 Ducats each

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates
conditions: Baro's stock changes each visit, so it may be missing on the next one.

disclosures.title: other routes
disclosures.body: During TennoCon, Baro's special Relay is open to anyone with a ticket, and his stock there covers almost everything he has sold. Unranked copies without Forma or Catalyst also trade between players, to a recipient at MR 10.

disclosures.title: Obex and Prisma Obex are separate Mastery
disclosures.body: Mastery is earned once per variant, so Prisma Obex is its own 3,000 points at rank 30.

rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step
